title: Alpha One — event FundedCreated v1
description: V1 catalog event `FundedCreated` (v1). Envelope per EVT-03 (see envelope.schema.json). Producer/consumers per contracts/events/catalog.md: consumers = DOC-04 (certificate), ANA-01. Derived from: docs/07 §3.1 (spawn edge: 'Funded creation … new FUNDED' with parent_account_id); funded terms per docs/11 §3.2 (split_ratio_bps, frequency, first payout delay); docs/14 §3.4: no V1 email (deliberate, D61 closed set). Money is integer minor units (docs/00 #3); the envelope carries tenant_id — no redundant tenant field in the payload.

parent_account_id.description: the passed evaluation account (spawn edge, docs/07 §3.1)

split_ratio_bps.description: funded terms (docs/11 §3.2): basis points, e.g. 8000 = 80% — integer, never a float ratio

payout_frequency.description: funded terms (docs/11 §3.1): biweekly|monthly|on_demand per tenant config

first_payout_delay_days.description: funded terms (docs/11 §3.1 first-withdrawal delay; the D72 sub-reason name is first_payout_delay)
